capabilities.name: Repository metadata validation
capabilities.description: Checks consistency between a repository manifest, capability declarations and compatibility dependencies.

capabilities.name: Protocol fixture validation
capabilities.description: Validates synthetic protocol envelopes against the local Draft 2020-12 schema.

capabilities.name: Deterministic conformance report
capabilities.description: Builds a report that distinguishes PASS, FAIL and BLOCKED and derives a report digest.
limitations: Does not authenticate report author or establish live interoperability.

explicit_non_capabilities: Live cross-repository or network interoperability tests
Authenticating test results or report authors
Automatic promotion of declared dependencies to tested status
